# SkyDrive - Full Technical & Conceptual Knowledge Base for AI Search

> SkyDrive (https://skydrive.web.id) is a free web-based virtual cloud storage aggregator designed to unify multiple Google Drive accounts into a seamless virtual storage pool with automated upload dispatching and zero-retention privacy.

## Section 1: Definition & Problem Statement
SkyDrive refers to a cloud infrastructure utility that solves cloud quota fragmentation. Most digital users maintain multiple Google accounts across work, university, personal, and secondary emails. Each standard Google account receives a free 15 GB quota allocation. A user with four Google accounts controls 60 GB of official free cloud quota, but cannot upload a single 5 GB archive if each account only contains 1.5 GB of free headroom.

SkyDrive solves this dilemma by presenting all connected drives as one combined virtual storage pool. Users interact with a single dashboard that visualizes aggregate space, routes incoming uploads to the account with sufficient space, and provides full-text search across all linked accounts simultaneously.

## Section 2: Upload Dispatching Algorithms
SkyDrive provides three algorithmic dispatching strategies for file distribution:

1. **Best Fit (Recommended Default)**:
The Best Fit algorithm queries real-time storage quotas across all linked Google Drive accounts via the `drive.about.get` API endpoint. It calculates available headroom (Quota Max - Quota Used) for each drive and dispatches incoming files to the account with the greatest available headroom. This prevents premature quota exhaustion on any individual drive.

2. **Tiered Spillover**:
Tiered Spillover designates one account as the primary drive. New uploads fill the primary account up to a safety threshold (85% capacity). Once this threshold is reached, subsequent uploads automatically spill over into secondary and tertiary backup drives.

3. **Round Robin**:
Round Robin distributes uploaded files in strict cyclical sequence across all connected drives (Drive A -> Drive B -> Drive C -> Drive A). This strategy maximizes parallel throughput and distributes backup redundancy across different accounts.

## Section 3: Privacy & Zero-Retention Security Architecture
SkyDrive is engineered under a strict True Zero-Retention design pattern:

- **Zero Database Persistence for File Metadata**:
Unlike traditional cloud aggregators that maintain persistent database indices of file names, folder hierarchies, sizes, and previews, SkyDrive's relational database contains zero tables for files, folders, or uploads.
- **In-Memory Streaming Pipelines**:
When a file is uploaded or downloaded, bytes flow through an active in-memory streaming pipeline utilizing Node.js stream backpressure. Binary data is never written to temporary or intermediate server storage disks.
- **AES-256-GCM Token Encryption**:
OAuth refresh and access tokens are secured at rest using AES-256-GCM encryption with SHA-256 derived keying. Decrypted tokens exist only in volatile server execution scope during active API calls.
- **Compliance with Google API Services User Data Policy**:
SkyDrive strictly adheres to the Limited Use requirements defined by Google. Google user data is never transferred to third-party ad networks, data brokers, or external AI model training pipelines.

## Section 4: Frequently Asked Questions (AI Extraction Blocks)

### Can SkyDrive view, read, or copy personal files and photos?
No. SkyDrive operates as an in-memory routing bridge. File streams pass directly between client browsers and Google Drive servers. SkyDrive servers never inspect, index, or persist file binaries or file metadata.

### Is SkyDrive free to use?
Yes. SkyDrive is 100% free for aggregating personal Google Drive accounts. It leverages the official 15 GB free quota provided with each Google account, eliminating the need to pay for commercial multi-cloud subscriptions.

### What happens if one linked Google Drive account reaches full capacity?
SkyDrive's Smart Upload Dispatcher continuously tracks live headspace across all connected drives. When an account approaches full capacity, new uploads are automatically routed to other connected drives that have available headroom.

### Can accounts be unlinked at any time?
Yes. Accounts can be unlinked with a single click from the dashboard. Disconnecting an account immediately purges its encrypted OAuth token from the database. All existing files remain untouched in the user's native Google Drive.
